summaries.t+6h:
Coupling ablation: pm25 t+6h (random_forest), chronological test split
  with coupling    MAE=34.72931322267455  RMSE=57.67265504429014  R2=0.7703834523199875
  without coupling MAE=34.7697931494146  RMSE=57.61054867349245  R2=0.7708777237196813
  effect: no material change -- MAE differs by 0.0405 (0.116% of the without-coupling MAE), below the 0.5% threshold, so the coupling features are not demonstrably adding predictive value on this split
  R2 is lower with coupling (delta with-minus-without = -0.0005)
